title: Working with Files
description: Node.js muhitida fayllarni o'qish, yozish, papkalar bilan ishlash va fayl yo'llarini to'g'ri quyish.

topics.title: Reading & Writing Files
topics.summary: Node.js'ning `fs` moduli bilan fayllarga yozish va o'qish

blocks.text: Brauzerda ishlaydigan TypeScript kod xavfsizlik sababli kompyuterdagi fayllarga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri kira olmaydi. Lekin **Node.js** muhitida (server, CLI vosita, skript) buyerilgan `fs` ("file system") moduli orqali fayl bilan to'liq ishlash mumkin.

Quyidagi barcha misollar **Node.js** muhitida ishlaydi (`node app.js` yoki `tsx app.ts`), brauzerda emas. Brauzer sahifasi faqat foydalanuvchi ochib bergan faylni o'qiy oladi — buning uchun **File System Access API** yoki oddiy `<input type="file">` ishlatiladi.
`fs` modulining deyarli har bir funksiyasi ikki xil ko'rinishda mavjud:

Sinxron funksiyalar butun dasturni **to'xtatib qo'yadi**, toki fayl operatsiyasi tugamaguncha. Server kodida (masalan, so'rovlarga javob beruvchi kodda) doim `fs/promises` bilan `async/await` ishlating.
Standart holatda `readFileSync` **Buffer** (xom baytlar) qaytaradi, matn emas. Matn kerak bo'lsa, ikkinchi argument sifatida kodlashni ko'rsating: `"utf-8"`.

examples.title: Sinxron o'qish va yozish
examples.code:
import { readFileSync, writeFileSync, appendFileSync } from "fs"

writeFileSync("notes.txt", "Birinchi qator\n")
appendFileSync("notes.txt", "Ikkinchi qator\n")

const content: string = readFileSync("notes.txt", "utf-8")
console.log(content)
console.log("Uzunlik:", content.length)

examples.title: fs/promises bilan asinxron ishlash
examples.code:
import { writeFile, readFile, unlink } from "node:fs/promises"

async function main() {
    await writeFile("async-test.txt", "Asinxron yozildi\n", "utf-8")
    await writeFile("async-test2.txt", "Ikkinchi fayl\n", "utf-8")

    // Ikkala faylni parallel o'qish
    const [content1, content2] = await Promise.all([
        readFile("async-test.txt", "utf-8"),
        readFile("async-test2.txt", "utf-8"),
    ])

    console.log("1-fayl:", content1.trim())
    console.log("2-fayl:", content2.trim())

    await Promise.all([unlink("async-test.txt"), unlink("async-test2.txt")])
    console.log("Fayllar o'chirildi")
}
main()

import { mkdtempSync, readFileSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs"
import { tmpdir } from "node:os"
import { basename, join } from "node:path"

const dir = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), "recipe-"))
const file = join(dir, "eslatma.txt")
writeFileSync(file, "Non olish\nSut olish\n")

console.log("papka nomi prefiksi:", basename(dir).startsWith("recipe-"))
console.log(readFileSync(file, "utf8").trim().split("\n"))
rmSync(dir, { recursive: true })

examples.description: Avval vaqtinchalik faylga, keyin rename — yarim yozilgan fayl qolmaydi.
examples.code:
import { existsSync, mkdtempSync, readFileSync, renameSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs"
import { tmpdir } from "node:os"
import { join } from "node:path"

function writeAtomic(path: string, data: string) {
    const tmp = `${path}.tmp`
    writeFileSync(tmp, data)
    renameSync(tmp, path) // bir qadamda almashtiriladi
}

const dir = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), "atom-"))
const file = join(dir, "state.json")
writeAtomic(file, JSON.stringify({ version: 1 }))
writeAtomic(file, JSON.stringify({ version: 2 }))
console.log(readFileSync(file, "utf8"), "| tmp qoldimi:", existsSync(`${file}.tmp`))
rmSync(dir, { recursive: true })

examples.title: Faylni kuzatish
examples.code:
import { mkdtempSync, rmSync, watch, writeFileSync } from "node:fs"
import { tmpdir } from "node:os"
import { join } from "node:path"

const dir = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), "watch-"))
const file = join(dir, "app.config")
writeFileSync(file, "v1")

let seen = false
const watcher = watch(file, () => {
    if (seen) return
    seen = true
    console.log("o'zgarish aniqlandi — konfiguratsiya qayta yuklanadi")
    watcher.close()
    rmSync(dir, { recursive: true })
})
setTimeout(() => writeFileSync(file, "v2"), 50)

readline bilan qator o'qish
examples.code:
import { mkdtempSync, writeFileSync, createReadStream, rmSync } from "node:fs"
import { createInterface } from "node:readline"
import { tmpdir } from "node:os"
import { join } from "node:path"
const dir = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), "rl-"))
const f = join(dir, "nums.txt")
writeFileSync(f, Array.from({ length: 5 }, (_, i) => i + 1).join("\n"))
let sum = 0
for await (const line of createInterface({ input: createReadStream(f) })) sum += Number(line)
console.log("yig'indi:", sum)
rmSync(dir, { recursive: true })

import { mkdtempSync, writeFileSync, createReadStream, createWriteStream, readFileSync, rmSync } from "node:fs"
import { pipeline } from "node:stream/promises"
import { tmpdir } from "node:os"
import { join } from "node:path"
const dir = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), "pl-"))
writeFileSync(join(dir, "src.txt"), "katta fayl mazmuni".repeat(3))

examples.title: gzip bilan siqish
examples.code:
import { mkdtempSync, writeFileSync, createReadStream, createWriteStream, statSync, rmSync } from "node:fs"
import { createGzip } from "node:zlib"
import { pipeline } from "node:stream/promises"
import { tmpdir } from "node:os"
import { join } from "node:path"
const dir = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), "gz-"))
writeFileSync(join(dir, "log.txt"), "takrorlanuvchi qator\n".repeat(1000))
await pipeline(createReadStream(join(dir, "log.txt")), createGzip(), createWriteStream(join(dir, "log.txt.gz")))
const before = statSync(join(dir, "log.txt")).size, after = statSync(join(dir, "log.txt.gz")).size
console.log(before, "→ kichraydi:", after < before / 10)
rmSync(dir, { recursive: true })

topics.title: The path Module
topics.summary: Turli operatsion tizimlarda ishlaydigan fayl yo'llarini quyish

blocks.text: Fayl yo'lini oddiy satrlarni `+` bilan qo'shib yasash **xavfli**: Windows'da bo'linuvchi `\`, Linux/macOS'da `/`. Node.js'ning **`path`** moduli bu farqni yashiradi va yo'llarni har doim to'g'ri quradi.

`__dirname` (CommonJS) yoki `import.meta.dirname` (ES modul, Node 20.11+) joriy faylning joylashgan papkasini beradi — u bilan `path.join` qo'shib, boshqa fayl qayerdan ishga tushirilishidan qat'i nazar to'g'ri ishlaydigan yo'l yasash mumkin.

examples.title: join va resolve farqi
examples.code:
import { join, resolve, basename, dirname, extname } from "path"

const relative = join("src", "utils", "math.ts")
const absolute = resolve("src", "utils", "math.ts")

console.log(relative)                     // nisbiy yo'l — o'zgarmaydi
console.log(absolute.includes("math.ts"))  // absolyut yo'l joriy papkaga bog'liq
console.log(basename("/home/user/report.pdf"))
console.log(dirname("/home/user/report.pdf"))
console.log(extname("archive.tar.gz"))

examples.title: Fayl nomi bilan ishlash
examples.code:
import { basename, extname, dirname, parse, format } from "node:path"

const filePath = "/projects/app/src/components/Button.test.tsx"

console.log("Fayl:", basename(filePath))
console.log("Kengaytmasiz:", basename(filePath, extname(filePath)))
console.log("Papka:", dirname(filePath))
console.log("Kengaytma:", extname(filePath))

const parsed = parse(filePath)
console.log("Qismlar:", { dir: parsed.dir, name: parsed.name, ext: parsed.ext })

const newPath = format({ ...parsed, base: undefined, name: "Button", ext: ".tsx" })
console.log("Yangi yo'l:", newPath)

examples.code:
import { mkdirSync, writeFileSync, readdirSync, statSync, rmSync } from "node:fs"
import { join } from "node:path"

const root = "size-demo"
mkdirSync(join(root, "sub"), { recursive: true })
writeFileSync(join(root, "a.txt"), "a".repeat(100))
writeFileSync(join(root, "b.txt"), "b".repeat(250))
writeFileSync(join(root, "sub", "c.txt"), "c".repeat(500))

function folderSize(dir: string): number {
    let total = 0
    for (const entry of readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) {
        const fullPath = join(dir, entry.name)
        total += entry.isDirectory() ? folderSize(fullPath) : statSync(fullPath).size
    }
    return total
}

console.log("Jami hajm:", folderSize(root), "bayt")
console.log("Ildizdagi fayllar:", readdirSync(root).length)

rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true })
